items.item_text: : Manages, analyzes, and reports on divisional finances associated with global IT costs, department operations, and student/staff personnel costs. Tracks actual expenses and personnel costs to budget, providing a clear and accurate picture of divisional financial status on a monthly basis. Creates and presents executive summaries of divisional finances to OIT and campus leadership. Creates multi-year models to plan for recurring campus IT costs and equipment refresh cycles.

: Manages procurement, reconciliation, invoicing, cost transfers, expense approvals, and other accounting processes associated with divisional operations. Oversees software vendor management, tracks renewals, and manages software cost-sharing for a variety of enterprise software solutions. Seeks advice and input from campus resources when necessary and provides strategic direction and innovative approaches to problem resolution to OIT leadership. Coordinates with UC Merced Budget, Procurement, Accounting, and Human Resources to ensure budget reporting, procurement, licensing, vendor relations, receiving, expense tracking, accounting, and human resources activities are managed toward timely and effective outcomes aligned to divisional priorities. Collaborates with and advises divisional leadership to ensure understanding of and adherence to policies and procedures associated with OIT operational and project-based activity.

Directs and manages the day to day operations of the OIT Business Office through direct reports and their subordinate staff. Selects, develops, and evaluates personnel to ensure the efficient business operations are maintained. Establishes work priorities, practices and procedures involving operational standards, personnel requirements and general administrative aspects of the team’s business systems. Develops, documents, and maintains efficient, transparent, and service-minded business practices that drive operational efficiency.
